main.description: UNCONFIRMED / best-effort shape — flag this before relying on it. The collection name net.bisks.hyperobject.suggestion is declared as a constant in public/index.html (SUGGEST_COLLECTION) for the "suggest a soul for the pit" flow non-owner signed-in users see, but no code in this site actually calls com.atproto.repo.createRecord or putRecord for it. The review checkpoint UI (renderDossier/reviewCurrent) reads a `queue` array and references `item.uri`, `item.note`, and `item.suggestedBy.handle` as if suggestions were real PDS records being reviewed, but loadQueue() unconditionally sets `queue = []` and never fetches anything — the review-queue feature is unimplemented/stubbed, not just unwritten. This lexicon is inferred from castInto()'s local "entry" object shape (the same one used for direct casts) plus the fields renderDossier expects a queue item to have, as a guess at what a real suggestion record would hold if this feature is finished. Confirm with whoever finishes the suggestion/review feature before treating this as ground truth — in particular, whether `suggestedBy` is meant to be a record field or is expected to be derived from the record's repo DID at read time (which is how the current dossier-rendering code seems to assume it, since it isn't in the local entry object at all). Presumed to be written by the suggesting (signed-in, non-isolyth.dev) account to their own repo. Read by hyperobject (https://hyperobject.bisks.net), if implemented.

subject.description: DID of the account being suggested for the pit. Inferred from castInto()'s local `entry.did`; unconfirmed as an actual record field.

note.description: Optional free-text note entered alongside the suggestion, mirroring the `note` field on castInto()'s local-only entry object. Unconfirmed as an actual record field.

createdAt.description: When the suggestion was submitted, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
